rs6311.sentence: Genotypes A/A + A/G of rs6311 are associated with increased severity of high-risk behaviors (self-injury, suicidality, harm to others) when treated with escitalopram in people with familial risk for bipolar I disorder and clinically significant depression and/or anxiety symptoms as compared to genotype G/G.
rs6311.explanation: In escitalopram-treated adolescents (12–17 years) at familial risk for bipolar I disorder, carriers of the −1438A allele (A/A or A/G) showed greater increases on the TEASAP high-risk behaviors subscale than G/G; the study reports this as a novel finding in a small sample without providing p-values in the excerpt.
